sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the ability of Israel to offer sacrifices stems from their level of attachment to G-d in the mode of "attachment of lights," while the sacrifices themselves sustain the world through the "attachment of vessels."

translations.translation: And based on this, it can be said,
that this which at the beginning of the section of offerings it is written "Adam ki yakriv" (When a man offers),
that this that Israel is called "Adam" is because of "and you who cling [to the L-rd your G-d],"
which is the attachment of lights,
it is,
because the power that Israel has to offer sacrifices is
(primarily)
because their attachment to the Holy One, blessed be He, is at the level of the attachment of lights.
And this that is stated in the Midrash, that the offering of sacrifices is connected with the level of attachment
(of the belt)
of vessels,
it can be said,
because the essence of sacrifices is that through them is the sustenance of the world,
[as it is brought in the Yerushalmi18
on the verse19
"To plant the heavens and to found the earth, these are the sacrifices,"
for through the sacrifices the statutes of heaven and earth are sustained20],
except that this power that is in sacrifices is because the one who offers the sacrifices is "Adam"
(who is above the world),
as it is brought in the Zohar21
that what is written "Adam ki yakriv"
[for among the four names Adam, Gevar, Enosh, Ish22,
the name Adam indicates the most supernal level, as it is written23
"And G-d created the Adam in His image"],
is because the sustenance of the upper and lower worlds is through the sacrifices.
Therefore,
also in the service of the man who offers, there must be two matters.
For the matter of the sacrifices themselves is through the service of man at the level of the vessels within him.
[For this that the sacrifices are the sustenance of the world is because they contain all the categories of the four inanimate, vegetative, living, and speaking of the world,
the sacrifices themselves which come from the inanimate, vegetative, and living,
and the man who offers24].
And the power in the sacrifices to sustain the world, because the one who offers them is a man who is separate from the world,
is through the service of man at the level of the lights within him.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The opening of the section of offerings with "Adam ki yakriv" indicates that the power to offer comes from the level of "Mah" (numerically "Adam") of the G-dly soul, which is the level of lights, while the actual offering involves the level of "Ban" (numerically "behemah") of the G-dly soul, the level of vessels.

translations.translation: And this is that the matter of "Adam ki yakriv" is specifically at the beginning of the section of offerings,
because the sacrifices themselves are from an animal, etc.,
for in this is also included the animal within man,
the animal soul25.
And this is done through the aspect of Ban of the G-dly soul26,
Ban having the numerical value of behemah (animal)27,
which, in general, is28
the soul as it is at the level of vessels.
Except that the power for this is through the aspect of Mah of the G-dly soul,
Mah having the numerical value of Adam (man)29,
which, in general, is28
the level of the lights of the soul,
and therefore the opening of the section of offerings is "Adam ki yakriv."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Torah and mitzvos correspond to lights and vessels, with mitzvos achieving the attachment of vessels and Torah study achieving the attachment of lights, which is the power behind the sacrifices, as explained in Tikkunei Zohar regarding prayer and Torah.

translations.translation: And it is known30
that Torah and mitzvos are analogous to lights and vessels.
And based on this, it can be said,
that the two levels mentioned above in the attachment of Israel to the Holy One, blessed be He,
are achieved through the study of Torah and the fulfillment of mitzvos.
Through the fulfillment of mitzvos – the attachment of vessels,
and through the occupation with Torah – the attachment of lights.
And based on this, we can connect this with what is brought in Tikkunei Zohar31,
that the three prayers, Shacharis, Minchah, and Maariv, correspond to lion, ox, and eagle,
and the matter of "Adam ki yakriv" is Torah.
And because of this, they instituted in prayer to read from a Torah scroll,
so that there should be in it a complete offering in Adam, etc., "This32
is the Torah, Adam."
And the explanation of this can be said,
that this that prayers correspond to sacrifices33
is corresponding to the sacrifices themselves
[for the matter of prayer is the refinement of the animal soul in the manner of the offering of an animal],
and the matter of "Adam ki yakriv" is Torah, it is the power of Israel to offer sacrifices because they are in the aspect of Adam,
the attachment of lights which is achieved through the occupation with Torah.
